crossRefs.note: When he was alone, those who were around him with the twelve asked him about the parables.
When he had come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, “Why couldn’t we cast it out?”

parallels.note: I begged your disciples to cast it out, and they couldn’t.”

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Then the disciples came to Jesus privately, and said, “Why weren’t we able to cast it out?”
translations.bsb: Afterward the disciples came to Jesus privately and asked, “Why couldn’t we drive it out?”
translations.kjv: Then came the disciples to Jesus apart, and said, Why could not we cast him out?
translations.asv: Then came the disciples to Jesus apart, and said, Why could not we cast it out?
